scope: Typed aliases only: actual primitive-polynomial real splitting, nonzero zeta-center value and existence of two distinct roots. These imported facts support the already-proved Turan/Newton inequalities; they do not prove individual centered-coefficient nonvanishing.
missing_interfaces_and_limits: No new axiom is introduced: the relevant upstream spectral facts are already proved. Introducing individual coefficient nonvanishing, or a spectral condition chosen only to restate it, would assume the outstanding target. The named HasDistinctRoots predicate means existence of two distinct roots, not squarefreeness. The false generic-distinctness justification is preserved in the literal statement below, not endorsed.
discharge_policy: Replace each new axiom by proof of the identical quantified statement; compile and audit each changed module and its dependent graph. Never merge axiom-dependent conclusions into certified main. A proof consuming a new axiom is conditional experimental work, not new A-Tier evidence.
